AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  September 11,2024
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair Ghazarian called the meeting to order at 5:09 pm.

  Present: Megrabyan, Hatamian, Chair Ghazarian
  Absent: Rihn

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration for the minutes of the July 10, 2024 meeting.

  Motion: Hatamian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOTa part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate ar decision.

  None

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Paula Adams reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Paula Adams reviewed the Eligible Lists Established Report.

6.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION AND JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL GENERAL MANAGER GLENDALE
  —  —

  WATER & POWER
  Action: Approve the revised class specification and job bulletin for General Manager Glendale Water &
  —

  Power as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

7.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION AND JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL— DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC WORKS
  Action: Approve the revised class specification and job bulletin for Director of Public Works as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

8.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL TREE TRIMMER SERIES
  —

  Action: Approve the revised class specification for the Tree Trimmer Series as submitted.
  As it applies to the entire Tree Trimmer Series, Commissioner Hatamian made a motion to amend the class
  specification to state: “Ability to maintain a commercial driver’s license throughout employment”.
  Commissioner Hatamian also proposed a change to the Senior Tree Trimmer experience requirement to be
  revised as follows: “Prior experience as a lead worker is required”.

  Motion: Hatamian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of September11, 2024
  Page 2 of 2

9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL BUDGET ANALYST
  —

  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Budget Analyst as submitted.
  Commissioner Hatamian directed HR Staff to decide on whether the Driver’s License should be a
  requirement prior to posting. Commissioner Megrabyan noted that the word “analyze” should be removed
  when it refers to legislation. As this item had previously received administrative approval by the Chair, the
  Commissioners directions will apply to future job bulletins.

  Motion: Hatamian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

10.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL ACCOUNTING SERIES AND ACCOUNTING MANAGEMENT SERIES
  —

  Action: Approve the class specification for Accounting Series and Accounting Management Series as
  submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

11.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL RECORDS ADMINISTRATION ANALYST
  —

  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Records Administration Analyst as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

12.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL CASE WORKER I
  —

  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Case Worker I as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

13.  REPORTS INFORMATION
  -

  a) Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Report

  Paula Adams reviewed the Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Reports.

14.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  No comments were made.

15.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 6:31 pm.

  We, the members oft Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true cord,ofourrnceedings of September11, 2024.

  Garo Ghazarian, Chair
